Hullmod.magellan_DefenseQuote: "You can't take every hit on your chin, and if you try, you just end up on your back, wondering why the ceiling spins so fast."
Hullmod.magellan_DefenseAttrib: attributed to Magellan boxer Romann Bermejo
Hullmod.magellan_FighterSPDesc1: The size of this ship's fighter wings is increased by %s/%s/%s, depending on the wing's size, up to a maximum wing size of %s fighters.
Hullmod.magellan_FighterSPDesc2: Fighter replacement time is increased by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_FighterSPExDesc1: Wings with 3 or fewer fighters gain +1 additional chassis,
Hullmod.magellan_FighterSPExDesc2: while wings with 4 fighters gain +2, and wings with 5 fighters gain +3.
Hullmod.magellan_FighterSPExDesc3: Wings with 6 fighters gain only +2 additional chassis for the maximum of 8.
Hullmod.magellan_FighterQuote: "You know what goes through a fighter pilot's head in combat? As little as possible, if she's good. Every thought is practical – or you die."
Hullmod.magellan_MovementSPDesc1: Top speed increased by %s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Zero-flux boost increased by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_MovementSPDesc2: Fuel use in hyperspace increased by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_MovementSPDesc3: Engine damage taken in combat is %s.
Hullmod.magellan_MovementQuote: "Fire without maneuver is a waste of ammunition. Maneuver without fire is begging for someone to call in artillery on your last known position."
Hullmod.magellan_ComCrewDesc2: Non-beam PD weapons receive a %s increase to range.
Hullmod.magellan_ComCrewDesc3: All weapons do %s more damage to fighters.
Hullmod.magellan_ComCrewQuote: "Oh aye, the 'decisive battle' doctrine – very popular upstairs. But ask the scuts who do the bleedin' and dyin' how it sounds t' them...'
Hullmod.magellan_ComCrewAttrib: overheard in Jeshad Station enlisted mess

Hullmod.magellan_AncientModDesc2: Chances of D-mods on recovery reduced by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_AncientModDesc3: Effects of D-mods on ship reduced by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_AncientModDesc4: Those echoes are the most uncanny things. You feel like you've heard something, so you go in to listen, then you hear it come back down from a long ways away...
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModDesc1: Ballistic and energy weapons range increased by %s, based on remaining system gauge.
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModDesc11: This is replaced by the %s range effect.
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModDesc2: Ballistic and energy weapons range increased by %s.
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModDesc3: Ballistic weapon rate of fire increased by %s
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote1: Navigation, where the hell are we? Where the hell is the Fleet?
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote2: Sensors... Sensors, what the hell is that?
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote3: No response to our hails, sir.
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote4: It's showing no signs of stopping either. All hands, battle stations!
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote5: Sir, 'X' turret took a hell of a hit, we've lost communitions!
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote6: Bulkheads 5 through 23 breached, sir! We're losing atmo fast!
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote7: We've lost all propulsion and the engine room isn't responding, Captain.
Hullmod.magellan_OverdriveModQuote8: Curse this hyperdrive! Curse this ship! Curse that void-bound monster! I'll be damned if I don't take you down with me!
Hullmod.magellan_CorvetteConversionModDesc1: Replaces one %s Fighter-Bomber Wing with one %s Corvette Wing.
Hullmod.magellan_CorvetteConversionModDesc2: Requires %s fighter bays to be installed with %s.
Hullmod.magellan_CorvetteConversionModDesc3: There is always a hammer and an anvil; opportunity and endurance. We serve their wills, but we are neither - we are the spark, the impact, the energy. And we wield the power to break both.
Hullmod.magellan_CorvetteConversionModDesc4: Bandits from Hell: The First AI War
Hullmod.magellan_BomberConversionModDesc1: Replaces one %s Fighter-Bomber Wing with one %s Missile Bomber Wing.
Hullmod.magellan_BomberConversionModDesc2: Requires %s fighter bays to be installed alongside %s.
Hullmod.magellan_BomberConversionModDesc3: You wear them down, bit by bit, until you can finish it with one good strike. And when you strike, strike hard, because the last thing you want is to give them a chance to get back up.
Hullmod.magellan_BomberConversionModDesc4: Bandits from Hell: The First AI War
Hullmod.magellan_FighterConversionCompatNoJitte: Can only be applied to ships with built-in Jitte [BCR] wings
